description:
The proposal consists of:
1. Replacement of the existing conservatory extension with a single storey rear and side infill extension.
2. New garden studio, located at the end of the rear garden.
3. Layout alterations to the main house, including new rooflights.
4. Addition of air conditioning.
decision_conditions: <div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The works hereby approved shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the approved Tree Protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement. The measures set out in the Tree Protection Plan shall remain in place until the completion of the construction.</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br>REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).&nbsp;&nbsp;</div>

<p>Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management and maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system for each of the rear extension and the outbuilding (i.e. water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard against flooding.&nbsp;</p>

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">All service runs shall fall outside the Root Protection Area(s) shown on the approved drawings, where possible.&nbsp; &nbsp;If service runs cannot be accommodated outside of Root Protection Areas, they should be installed using trenchless techniques&nbsp;unless otherwise first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; Any such works shall be carried out in accordance with the National Joint Utilities Group; Volume 4 (2007) (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard).</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: &nbsp;To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020). Approval is required upfront to ensure that important trees are not permanently damaged or lost.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">No works shall commence on site unless details of Arboricultural Monitoring of the site to include details of (i) person(s) to conduct the monitoring; (ii) the methodology and programme for reporting; and (iii) a timetable for inspections, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The works shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the details so approved.</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).&nbsp; Approval is required upfront to ensure that important trees are not permanently damaged or lost.</span></p>
